test_title: PYST 6: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - Quant (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: From the top of a 100 m high cliff, an observer notices a car moving away from the base of the cliff. The angle of depression of the car changes from 45° to 30° in 8 seconds. What is the approximate speed of the car?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Distance covered by the car = Height × (cot θ₂ − cot θ₁)

Distance = 100 × (cot 30° − cot 45°) = 100 × (√3 − 1)

Distance ≈ 100 × (1.732 − 1) = 73.2 m

Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 73.2 ÷ 8 = 9.15 m/s

Approximate speed ≈ 9.2 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 9.2 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of the cliff (AB) = 100 m

Initial angle of depression = 45° → Angle of elevation at C = 45°

Final angle of depression = 30° → Angle of elevation at D = 30°

Time taken (t) = 8 seconds

**Formula Used:**

tan θ = Perpendicular ÷ Base

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5444c61b539ed00a2226f2cf0e8d1184adaf9672b39ed7b59b5bb07049cc9e3c.png] 

In right-angled ▵ABC:

⇒ tan 45° = AB ÷ BC

⇒ 1 = 100 ÷ BC

⇒ BC = 100 m

In right-angled ▵ABD:

⇒ tan 30° = AB ÷ BD

⇒ 1 ÷ √3 = 100 ÷ BD

⇒ BD = 100√3 m

Distance covered by the car (CD):

⇒ CD = BD − BC

⇒ CD = 100√3 − 100

⇒ CD = 100 × (1.732 − 1) = 100 × 0.732 = 73.2 m

Speed of the car:

⇒ Speed = Distance ÷ Time

⇒ Speed = 73.2 ÷ 8

⇒ Speed = 9.15 m/s ≈ 9.2 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 9.2 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle of Depression

It is the angle formed between the horizontal line and the observer's line of sight to an object placed below the horizontal level.

Trigonometric Ratios

For standard angles: tan 30° = 1/√3, tan 45° = 1, and tan 60° = √3. Also, √3 ≈ 1.732 and √2 ≈ 1.414.

Speed Conversion

To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5. To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18.</p
